name: Tsushima Current
scope: Japanese coastal-branch reference corridor from an OSW eastern Tsushima Strait approach to a western Tsugaru Strait approach. Excludes the offshore/Korean branch, Soya continuation and the separately named Tsugaru outflow. Connecting vertices do not assert uninterrupted flow or a full-system length. Downstream merges are shared circulation context, not exclusive nearshore water-parcel continuity.
layer: Upper-ocean Japanese coastal branch naming context; source distinguishes coastal and offshore pathways. No depth-specific velocity axis or thermal-front width reconstructed.
time_convention: General regional circulation context in Yoon et al. (2016), Yokomatsu and Kida (online 2024; issue 2025) and JMA explanatory pages. Not a contemporaneous trajectory, annual mean axis or seasonal length series.
source_locator: Section 1, paragraphs beginning The TWC approaching and Part of the merged: Nearshore Branch from eastern channel to Tsugaru along Japanese coast; downstream merged branches do not preserve exclusive component identity.
source_citation: Yoon et al. (2016), An east-west contrast of upper ocean heat content variation south of the subpolar front in the East/Japan Sea, Journal of Geophysical Research: Oceans 121, 6418-6443, doi:10.1002/2016JC011891.

supporting_sources.citation: Japan Meteorological Agency, What is the Tsushima Warm Current? (Japanese explanatory page), accessed 2026-10-03.
supporting_sources.locator: Opening paragraph and section Tsushima Warm Current pathway.
supporting_sources.role: Tsushima inflow, Tsugaru/Soya exits and often discontinuous flow context; not coordinates, a measured axis or branch length.

supporting_sources.role: Japan Sea Throughflow inflow/outflow naming; no merger of Tsushima, Tsugaru and Soya lengths.
Coastal versus offshore broad pathway classification; not a contradictory claim that every source uses exactly two branches.

coordinate_selection: Every vertex and gate is OSW-selected offshore reference geography. Sources support named branch and inlet/outlet context but do not publish this axis, exact named endpoints or whole-current length. Alternative approach gates test regional convention. Shelf/bathymetry and island clearance require separate review. Neither 100 m thermal-front contours, 10 C warm-water area index nor Tsushima Strait dimensions are current width; no seasonal geometry digitized.

alternative_routes.interpretation: OSW shorter inlet and western Tsugaru approaches on the same Japanese coastal corridor; not an alternative offshore/Korean branch or observed seasonal path.

scenario_rule: Two regional approach-gate conventions crossed with longitude and independent endpoint latitude offsets -0.05/0/+0.05 degrees: 54 editorial scenarios, not branch persistence, seasonal variation or measured endpoint/width uncertainty.
